summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report) announcing the Board's appointment of José Eduardo Barreneche Ávila as Corporate Compliance Officer effective no later than October 20, 2026, with Julio Ricardo Corredor Calderón serving as Acting Compliance Officer from October 14, 2026. The prior officer, Rodolfo Mario García, left via a mutually agreed termination effective October 13, 2026. The filing is framed as part of an ongoing strategy to strengthen senior management. No deal terms, advisors, or shareholder-vote mechanics are involved; the event is a scheduled officer transition rather than a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO departure, so it is treated as a management-change disclosure. What to watch: any subsequent 6-K or 20-F disclosure on related governance/SEC compliance matters.
